prose: Ceb Bland joins Vibe Rant tonight to recount tales of his various paranormal, mystical, and supernatural experiences. Out of body travel, Sasquatch sightings, elven encounters, and spiritual masters seem to flock to certain people, but why? Perhaps tonight we'll get to the bottom of it! Sure to be a fun time, either way!
